name: Stark Novus Financial Inc.
summary: Stark Novus Financial Inc. does not have significant operations. It intends to identify, evaluate, and pursue one or more potential business combinations or acquisitions. Previously, the company was engaged in the manufacture and sale of Endurance, an electric full-size pickup truck. The company was formerly known as Nu Ride Inc. and changed its name to Stark Novus Financial Inc. in July 2026. The company is headquartered in New York, New York.
